channel.title: Kimi Research Articles & Technical Blogs
channel.description: Explore Kimi research articles, technical blogs, and benchmark releases

item.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
item.description: Kimi K2 is our latest Mixture-of-Experts model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in frontier knowledge, math, and coding among non-thinking models.

item.title: Kimi K3 Tech Blog: Open Frontier Intelligence
item.description: Kimi K3 is the world's first open 3T-class model — frontier performance across coding, knowledge work, and reasoning, with native multimodality and 1M context.

item.title: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in MLLMs
item.description: PerceptionBench evaluates visual perception at the level of atomic capabilities discovered from model failures, measuring what multimodal models actually see rather than what they infer.

item.title: Kimi K2.6 Tech Blog: Advancing Open-Source Coding
item.description: Kimi K2.6 advances open-source coding, featuring long-horizon coding, coding-driven design, agent swarms, proactive agents, and the Claw Groups research preview.

item.title: Kimi Agent Swarm: 100 Sub-Agents at Scale
item.description: Kimi Agent Swarm is a self-organizing multi-agent system that spawns up to 100 sub-agents to parallelize research, document synthesis, and multi-perspective analysis.

item.title: WorldVQA: Measuring Atomic World Knowledge in MLLMs
item.description: WorldVQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate atomic vision-centric world knowledge in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

item.title: Kimi K2.5 Tech Blog: Visual Agentic Intelligence
item.description: Kimi K2.5 defines Visual Agentic Intelligence. Trained on 15T tokens, it introduces SOTA visual coding and autonomous agent swarm. Read the full tech blog.

item.title: Kimi Vendor Verifier
item.description: Rebuilding the "Chain of Trust" -- Kimi Vendor Verifier.

item.title: Kimi K2 Thinking
item.description: Kimi K2 Thinking, Moonshot's best open-source thinking model.
